base_selection: equal-mask source-selection MSE; then fixed for all uncertainty arms
direct_heteroscedastic_control: Likelihood-fit continuous beta in [0,1], separately for 6 and 12 observed coordinates; Student-t df grid includes all Bayesian conditional df values. All scales recalibrated using the same twelve source trajectories.
bayesian_model: Shared per-window inverse-gamma residual scale; condition on visible residuals, integrate scale for hidden-future Student-t prediction. Covariance and hyperparameters empirical Bayes, not fully integrated.
calibration: Every independent arm gets the same twelve calibration trajectories; Bayesian arm recalibrates prior scale, direct controls recalibrate output scales. Exact-moment Gaussian intentionally inherits Bayesian moments; separately recalibrated Gaussian also included.
mean_parity: All seven arms use exactly the same source-fitted empirical conditional mean
primary_score: equal-object/equal-trajectory/equal-mask joint negative log density per hidden coordinate at +30 frames
secondary_scores: Brier for absolute hidden-coordinate prediction error above 20 mm

bootstrap.unit: complete trajectory stratified within each of two fixed physical objects
